channel.title: WIB Research Reports
channel.description: Original research from WIB editorial team on India healthcare, dining, travel, cities, education.

item.title: Metro vs Tier-3 India: A Side-by-Side Reality Check (2026)
item.description: Direct comparison of 8 Indian metros vs 5 tier-3 cities on healthcare, dining, education, and cost of living. Tier-3 wins on cost, trails on hospital quality (29-pt NABH gap) and elite education.

item.title: Regional Cuisine Renaissance: India's Tier-3 Dining (2026)
item.description: 50 verified restaurants across Bhopal, Nagpur, Mysore, Vadodara and Patna reveal that regional cuisines (Saoji, Bhopali Mughlai, Mysore tiffin, Gujarati thali, Bihari litti chokha) outscore generic multi-cuisine in tier-3 India.

item.title: Beyond the Metros: Hospital Access in India's Tier-3 Cities (2026)
item.description: WIB analyses 40 multi-specialty hospitals across Bhopal, Nagpur, Mysore, Vadodara and Patna. NABH coverage gap (68% vs 97% in metros), specialty depth, and the patient-flight question for cancer and transplant care.

item.title: Education Affordability Index India 2026
item.description: WIB analyses what it actually costs to educate one Indian child from K to PG in 2026. Rs 8L to Rs 4.5Cr — the 56x cost spread.

item.title: India City Living Index 2026
item.description: WIB ranks 8 Indian metros across 9 dimensions of livability — cost, jobs, healthcare, schools, weather, transport, AQI, food, lifestyle.

item.title: State of Indian Travel 2026
item.description: WIB research on India domestic travel: 102 destinations, 12-month weather windows, weekend getaway analysis, state-by-state distribution.

item.title: State of Indian Restaurants 2026
item.description: WIB annual research on Indian dining: 450 restaurants across 15 cities, cuisine concentration, premium-vs-budget split, city personalities.

item.title: State of Indian Hospitals 2026
item.description: WIB annual research on India hospital landscape: 306 multi-specialty hospitals across 15 cities, NABH coverage, specialty distribution, bed capacity.
